tips.text: Rank Steel Meridian first so Red Veil climbs alongside it for free.
Check where all three syndicates stand before you start; earlier Perrin, New Loka or Arbiters grinding can leave them deep in the negative.
Ignore old guides that list Archwing mission drops; the parts only come from the syndicates.
Join or start a clan with a Tenno Lab; the blueprint has no other source.
Farm the 2 Argon Crystals only after all three parts are in hand; they decay while you grind standing.
Fold the Fluctus into standing you already earn with Steel Meridian and Red Veil instead of grinding it on its own.
